description: This file defines a structure and methods for discovering Wide Area Gateways using DNS and Tailscale status information in a Swift application. It includes network probing, DNS querying, and JSON parsing functionalities.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Discovers Wide Area Gateways by querying DNS records and checking Tailscale node statuses.

methods.name: collectTailnetIPv4s
methods.description: Extracts IPv4 addresses associated with the Tailnet from Tailscale status JSON.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to read the current Tailscale status in JSON format by executing system commands.

methods.name: loadWideAreaPtrRecords
methods.description: Loads DNS PTR records for Wide Area Gateways using a DNS query via the dig utility.

methods.name: runDig
methods.description: Executes the 'dig' command with specified arguments and timeout.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Generic process runner to execute external commands and capture output.

methods.name: parseSrv
methods.description: Parses SRV DNS query output to extract hostname and port.

methods.name: parseTxtTokens
methods.description: Parses TXT DNS record lines into tokens, handling quoted strings.

methods.name: mapTxt
methods.description: Converts TXT tokens into a key-value dictionary.

methods.name: decodeDnsSdEscapes
methods.description: Decodes DNS-SD escape sequences in TXT records.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer if possible.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a given IP address string belongs to the Tailnet IPv4 range.
